sql: SELECT policy, coalesce(end_reason, '(open)') AS reason, count(*) AS n, round(avg(rest_seconds)::numeric) AS avg_rest_s, round(max(rest_seconds)::numeric) AS max_rest_s, min(placed_at) AS first_at, max(placed_at) AS last_at, now() AS db_now FROM incentive_shadow_quotes WHERE placed_at >= '2026-11-08T15:40:00Z' AND policy IN ('S1','S2-best') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC
